description: Tamil Nadu Government restructures AI agencies to enhance AI economy, establishing TNAIM as a non-profit and launching TNAIV.
body_lead: To position Tamil Nadu at the forefront of the growing AI economy, the new TVK-led government of Tamil Nadu has announced a reorganisation of the Tamil Nadu Artificial Intelligence Mission (TNAIM). Under the new changes, the TNAIM will be renewed and incorporated as a Section 8 not-for-profit company while a new government company called the Tamil Nadu AI Vision (TNAIV) will function as the commercial arm of the mission, according to the government’s 2026-27 policy note for the Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology and Digital Services Department.
